function bucket<K extends number>(k: K, r: number[][], value: number): void {
  (r[k] ??= []).push(value);
}
const rows: number[][] = [];
bucket(0, rows, 1);
bucket(0, rows, 2);
bucket(2, rows, 3);
console.log(rows);

function group<K extends number>(k: K, r: Record<number, string[]>, value: string): void {
  (r[k] ||= []).push(value);
}
const groups: Record<number, string[]> = {};
group(1, groups, "a");
group(1, groups, "b");
console.log(groups);

function byName<K extends string>(k: K, r: Record<string, number[]>): number[] {
  return (r[k] ??= []);
}
const names: Record<string, number[]> = {};
byName("x", names).push(4);
console.log(names);

function first<K extends string | number>(k: K, r: { [key: string]: number }): number {
  return r[k];
}
console.log(first("a", { a: 5 }), first(0, { 0: 6 }));
